parsed.post: Kept the ASPECT_RATIO=64 improvement (1.005966). The drop to 0.983798 in the latest run is significant, but I am not seeing any explicit change in my hyperparameters in the run_log to explain it—I likely misread my own intent or a parameter change occurred. I will now formally apply WEIGHT_DECAY=0.01 and reduce MATRIX_LR to 0.04 to stabilize this wide model.
parsed.description: Applying regularization and a lower learning rate to the high-capacity (ASPECT_RATIO=64, DEPTH=6) model to see if it stabilizes the improved performance.
